metadata.title: Broadcom's price sinks over 6% after releasing Q3 earnings

content.text:
Market Domination Overtime host Josh Lipton reports that Broadcom's (AVGO) price fell more than 6% after the company released its earnings report as CEO Hock Tan tried to reassure investors.
